description: Pilot template emphasizing structured requirements and policy hooks for an Azure-hosted internal API. Use this as a starting point when stakeholders already captured bullets in ticketing tools and want them mirrored into ArchLucid ingestion fields without attaching large files.
constraints: All PII flows must stay in-region; no cross-border analytics without explicit exception
requiredCapabilities: Observable request path with correlation IDs end-to-end
assumptions: Workforce identity is OIDC-backed; no legacy LDAP bind in the happy path
inlineRequirements: Document retention for audit logs must meet 7-year policy for finance data classes
Disaster recovery exercises must be runnable without production write access
Rate limits and quotas must be enforced at the edge before application code
topologyHints: Prefer hub-and-spoke network for shared services; isolate team sandboxes
securityBaselineHints: CIS Azure Foundations controls for logging and monitoring
No public storage accounts for application payloads
